intro.text: A shipbuilding city on Roshar whose yards are sheltered from both highstorms and the Everstorm.
A large port, also called simply Klna, on the northern tip of Thaylenah on Longbrow's Straits to the east of Thaylen City. Its shipyards are sheltered from both highstorms and the Everstorm.

description.text: Vstim had the ship Wandersail built there as a gift for Rysn.
